text: They sat in the sun outside the post office, and for a long time Wren just held the locket.
The night you were born, a ship hit the rocks. Your mother rowed out to it alone. She never came back.
Except she did, Gus. This autumn. She came to my door in a yellow coat, and asked me for the key.
Gus had spent his whole life keeping a light for a mother he thought the sea had taken.
The sea had given her back. And she had come home to put the light out.
